title: Invoice CSV export keeps long and unusual names whole in their cells
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, a customer the work is for, with a long name with spaces that no other customer has, at least 60 characters (for example Northern Plains Heavy Truck and Trailer Repair Services West).
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer C, a second customer the work is for, with a name that no other customer has and that includes each of the characters & " ' < > (for example A&B "Fleet" O'Neil <Parts> & Sons).
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the payer, whose name is customer A's name with every space taken out (for example NorthernPlainsHeavyTruckandTrailerRepairServicesWest).
  • If a name field stops before the end of a name, use the longest name it takes.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, invoiced today, billed to customer B.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 2, for customer C, invoiced today, billed to customer B.
  • Start on the page that exports the invoice list.
custom_steps:
1. Export the invoice list to CSV.
  2. Open the CSV file in a spreadsheet program.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • A CSV file downloads.

Step 2:

  • Work order 1's invoice row reads customer B's whole name under "Customer" and customer A's whole name under "Service Customer".
  • Work order 2's invoice row reads customer B's whole name under "Customer" and customer C's name under "Service Customer".
  • Customer C's name shows exactly as saved: the & " ' < > characters appear as typed, not changed into other characters or codes.
  • No name is split across two cells: every row has its values under the same headings as the heading row.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12321 (Story 19, IBS, invoice export and Public API)

  • S19-R5: “In the invoice CSV export, "Customer" is the Bill To and "Terms" is the term saved on the invoice.”
  • S19-R6: “The export's last column, "Service Customer", names the customer the work was for when someone else is billed.”
